entries.en: The solver found a feasible timetable without assigning any teacher to two classes at once.
entries.zh: 求解程序找到了一个可行的课表，没有让任何教师同时上两节课。

entries.en: Three unfilled jars stood beside the pot of cooling jam.
entries.zh: 三个尚未装入东西的罐子放在那锅正在冷却的果酱旁。

entries.en: The lunar terminator crossed the crater, leaving half its floor in shadow.
entries.zh: 月球的明暗界限穿过这个坑穴，使坑底的一半处于阴影中。

entries.en: The operating-system lecture explained how paging maps virtual addresses to physical memory.
entries.zh: 操作系统课讲解了页式调度如何将虚拟地址映射到物理内存。

entries.en: The cook checked the steak for doneness before carrying it to the table.
entries.zh: 厨师检查了牛排的熟度，然后才把它端上桌。

entries.en: She used tempera to paint the small panel, building up the colours in thin layers.
entries.zh: 她用蛋彩画法绘制这块小画板，一层层薄薄地叠加颜色。

entries.en: Her seminar paper examines the intentionality of memories of a childhood home.
entries.zh: 她的研讨课论文考察了对童年故居的记忆所具有的意向性。

entries.en: The harmonization of the two laboratories’ reporting rules made their results easier to compare.
entries.zh: 两家实验室报告规则的一致化，使它们的结果更便于比较。

entries.en: A roadie wheeled the amplifiers off the stage after the final song.
entries.zh: 最后一首歌结束后，一名巡回乐队管理员把音箱从舞台上推走。

entries.en: The programmer’s test failed after the reassignment of the counter from zero to minus one.
entries.zh: 计数器从零被重赋值为负一后，程序员的测试失败了。

entries.en: The museum’s new gallery traces the teaching of naval gunnery through old training manuals.
entries.zh: 博物馆的新展厅通过旧训练手册，追溯海军射击学的教学历史。

entries.en: The spectrometer resolved the bright feature into a doublet of closely spaced lines.
entries.zh: 光谱仪把那条明亮的谱线分辨成了一对间隔很近的谱线。

entries.en: The homebound passengers waited on platform four after their evening shift.
entries.zh: 下晚班后，回家的乘客们在四号站台等候。

entries.en: In the old match report, the halfback intercepted a pass and sent the ball towards the left wing.
entries.zh: 在那篇旧足球赛报道中，前卫截住一次传球，并把球传向左翼。

entries.en: We decided to carpool to the conference because the venue had only a small car park.
entries.zh: 我们决定拼车去参加会议，因为会场只有一个小停车场。

entries.en: She formally withdrew her candidature before the committee printed the ballot papers.
entries.zh: 在委员会印制选票前，她正式退出了候选人行列。

entries.en: The network engineer used a sniffer to inspect traffic on the laboratory’s own test network.
entries.zh: 网络工程师用嗅探器检查了实验室自有测试网络上的流量。

entries.en: The catalogue lists the new racing marque with a smaller engine than the previous model.
entries.zh: 目录中列出的新赛车型号，其发动机比上一款车型更小。

entries.en: The calibration graph showed good linearity across the sensor’s normal operating range.
entries.zh: 校准图显示，在传感器的正常工作范围内，线性表现良好。

entries.en: The historian’s chapter describes the disenfranchisement of an entire class of voters.
entries.zh: 历史学家的这一章描述了整整一类选民被剥夺选举权的情况。

entries.en: Her essay on educational essentialism argues for a shared core of mathematics and literature.
entries.zh: 她关于基本教育论的文章主张设置共同的数学和文学核心课程。

entries.en: The pastoralist led her sheep to a valley where the grass was still green.
entries.zh: 这位放牧者把她的羊群赶到一处草仍然青绿的山谷。

entries.en: Under the microscope, a silver dendrite spread across the electrode like a tiny tree.
entries.zh: 在显微镜下，一枚银树枝晶像小树一样在电极表面伸展开来。

entries.en: The pianist worked as a sideman for a touring singer before recording his own album.
entries.zh: 这位钢琴家曾为一名巡演歌手伴奏，后来才录制了自己的专辑。

entries.en: The chemist studied compartmentalization in droplets that kept two reaction mixtures apart.
entries.zh: 这位化学家研究了液滴中的区室化，这些液滴使两种反应混合物彼此分开。

entries.en: She soaked an ancho in warm water before blending it into the sauce.
entries.zh: 她先把一只干波布拉诺椒放在温水里浸泡，再将它搅入酱汁。

entries.en: An endnote on the final page identifies the archive that holds the original letter.
entries.zh: 最后一页的一条尾注注明了收藏那封原信的档案馆。

entries.en: The report documented the pilot’s temporary incapacitation during the flight.
entries.zh: 报告记录了飞行员在飞行期间暂时丧失履职能力的情况。

entries.en: The laboratory camera recorded cavitation inside the transparent model of a water pump.
entries.zh: 实验室摄像机记录了透明水泵模型内部的空化现象。

entries.en: As a sextuplet, Anna shared her birthday with five brothers and sisters.
entries.zh: 安娜是六胞胎之一，她和五个兄弟姐妹同一天过生日。

entries.en: The depot reduced the turnround of each freight wagon by unloading it before dawn.
entries.zh: 货运站在黎明前卸货，缩短了每辆货车的周转时间。

entries.en: Changing the password triggered the invalidation of every existing session token.
entries.zh: 更改密码使所有现有的会话令牌失效。

entries.en: The driver had to downshift before the car could climb the steep hill.
entries.zh: 司机不得不调低挡位，汽车才能爬上陡坡。

entries.en: The building’s incompletion left the top floor exposed to the rain.
entries.zh: 由于建筑尚未完工，顶层仍暴露在雨中。

entries.en: The damp fibres began to ball up as the drum turned.
entries.zh: 滚筒转动时，潮湿的纤维开始滚成球。

entries.en: The metalworker used a small hammer to beat out the dents in the copper tray.
entries.zh: 金属工人用小锤子把铜托盘上的凹痕敲平。

entries.en: We can hang out the blankets once the rain stops.
entries.zh: 雨停后，我们就可以把毯子挂到外面晾晒。

entries.en: The teacher gave an object lesson using real leaves and seeds from the school garden.
entries.zh: 老师用学校花园里的真实叶片和种子上了一堂实物教学课。

entries.en: A peregrine falcon perched on the church tower above the square.
entries.zh: 一只游隼栖息在广场上方的教堂塔楼上。

entries.en: We had to shut in the hens for the night before leaving the farm.
entries.zh: 离开农场前，我们不得不把母鸡关起来过夜。

entries.en: Could you walk over to the reception desk and ask for a spare key?
entries.zh: 你能走到接待处去，问问有没有备用钥匙吗？

entries.en: The warehouse clerk checked each crate against the bill of goods.
entries.zh: 仓库职员对照货品清单，逐一核查每只货箱。

entries.en: The dry twigs began to blaze out, lighting the faces around the campfire.
entries.zh: 干树枝开始燃烧起来，照亮了营火周围人们的脸。

entries.en: The winger approached the defender’s blind side while his teammate drew attention to the ball.
entries.zh: 队友用球吸引注意力时，边锋靠近了后卫无防备的一侧。

entries.en: The engineer compared the body structure of the two hatchbacks.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了这两款掀背车的车身结构。

entries.en: The owners plan to brick over the muddy courtyard before opening the café.
entries.zh: 店主们计划在咖啡馆开业前，用砖铺好泥泞的庭院。

entries.en: The furniture workshop grew into a business enterprise employing forty local people.
entries.zh: 这间家具作坊逐步发展成一家雇用四十名当地人的工商企业。

entries.en: We can buy at the lower price only if we order twenty boxes.
entries.zh: 我们只有订购二十箱，才能按较低的价格买入。

entries.en: A car carrier waited outside the harbour with hundreds of vehicles on board.
entries.zh: 一艘载着数百辆汽车的汽车运载船在港外等候。

entries.en: Please carry back the empty baskets when you return from the orchard.
entries.zh: 从果园回来时，请把空篮子拿回来。

entries.en: The children stood behind the chalk line across the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子们站在操场上横画的粉笔线后面。

entries.en: He borrowed a church key to remove the metal cap from his soda bottle.
entries.zh: 他借了一个瓶起子，打开汽水瓶的金属瓶盖。

entries.en: She could click off the names of every station on the line without consulting the map.
entries.zh: 她不用看地图，就能迅速准确地说出这条线路上每一站的站名。

entries.en: My glasses began to cloud up as I stepped into the warm kitchen.
entries.zh: 我走进温暖的厨房时，眼镜开始蒙上一层雾，变得模糊。

entries.en: The demand model uses a coefficient of elasticity of minus two for that product.
entries.zh: 这个需求模型对该产品采用负二的弹性系数。

entries.en: The technician measured the coefficient of friction between the rubber pad and the steel plate.
entries.zh: 技术员测量了橡胶垫与钢板之间的磨擦系数。

entries.en: The manufacturer hired a commercial agency to handle orders from overseas retailers.
entries.zh: 制造商聘请一家商业代理所，处理海外零售商的订单。

entries.en: The diagram marks the common chord joining the two circles’ points of intersection.
entries.zh: 图中标出了连接两个圆交点的公弦。

entries.en: The charity dinner added three thousand pounds to the community chest.
entries.zh: 这场慈善晚宴为募集的社区救济基金增加了三千英镑。

entries.en: The team used computer-aided design to test several bridge layouts before building a model.
entries.zh: 团队在制作模型前，用计算机辅助设计测试了几种桥梁布局。

entries.en: The surveyor unfolded a contour sheet to check the slope above the proposed reservoir.
entries.zh: 测量员展开一张等高线图，查看拟建水库上方的坡度。

entries.en: The museum model labels a control rod beside the reactor’s fuel assembly.
entries.zh: 博物馆的模型在反应堆燃料组件旁标出了一根控制棒。

entries.en: Her appointment letter confirmed the date of a corneal transplant.
entries.zh: 她的预约信确认了角膜移植的日期。

entries.en: The anatomy student labelled a cuneiform bone in the model of the foot.
entries.zh: 解剖学学生在足部模型上标出了一块楔骨。

entries.en: In the final scene, the actor had to dash down the wooden cup in anger.
entries.zh: 在最后一幕中，演员要愤怒地把木杯猛地掷下。

entries.en: To declare oneself neutral while funding one side is hardly convincing.
entries.zh: 一边资助其中一方，一边宣称自己中立，很难令人信服。

entries.en: The essay pauses to descant on the use of light in the architect’s early buildings.
entries.zh: 这篇文章暂且转而评论这位建筑师早期建筑中的光线运用。

entries.en: One desert boot was missing its lace when he unpacked his bag.
entries.zh: 他打开包整理物品时，发现有一只沙漠靴少了鞋带。

entries.en: When the chair retires, responsibility for the archive will devolve on the deputy.
entries.zh: 主席退休后，档案管理责任将移交给副主席。

entries.en: The test compared direct transmission to the server with transmission through a relay.
entries.zh: 这项测试比较了向服务器直接传输与经过中继传输两种方式。

entries.en: The display window on the meter showed a steady reading of twelve volts.
entries.zh: 仪表的显示窗显示稳定的十二伏读数。

entries.en: During dramatic play, the children turned a cardboard box into a pretend shop.
entries.zh: 在表演游戏中，孩子们把一个纸箱当成了模拟商店。

entries.en: The gardener returned to earth up the potatoes along the edge of the plot.
entries.zh: 园丁回来给菜地边上的马铃薯培土。

entries.en: The hikers had to edge up the narrow slope beside the fallen tree.
entries.zh: 徒步者们不得不沿倒下的树旁的狭窄斜坡，慢慢向上挪动。

entries.en: The physics exercise asks students to calculate the electrical work done by the battery.
entries.zh: 这道物理练习题要求学生计算电池所做的电功。

entries.en: The technician calibrated the electronic instrument before measuring the sample’s temperature.
entries.zh: 技术员先校准了电子仪器，再测量样品的温度。

entries.en: The restoration will enter upon a new phase when the roof repairs are complete.
entries.zh: 屋顶修复完成后，修复工程将开始一个新阶段。

entries.en: The executive officer coordinated the council’s response to the damaged water main.
entries.zh: 这位行政官员协调了市政机构对供水总管损坏的应对工作。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the raiders wait until dusk to fall upon the camp.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，袭击者等到黄昏才进攻营地。

entries.en: The breeder recorded which tomato plant served as the female parent in the cross.
entries.zh: 育种者记录了这次杂交中由哪一株番茄植株充当母本。

entries.en: The surgical diagram marks the field of operation with a dotted outline.
entries.zh: 手术示意图用虚线轮廓标出了手术区。

entries.en: The nozzle released a fine spray that settled on the fern leaves.
entries.zh: 喷嘴喷出一层细雾，落在蕨类植物的叶片上。

entries.en: Our first period on Monday is mathematics, so I packed the geometry set.
entries.zh: 星期一我们的第一节课是数学课，所以我装好了几何绘图工具。

entries.en: The support chatbot searches the company’s knowledge base before suggesting an answer.
entries.zh: 客服聊天机器人会先检索公司的知识库，再给出建议答案。

entries.en: The program prints the imaginary part of 4 + 3i as 3, not 3i.
entries.zh: 程序把 4 + 3i 的虚部输出为 3，而不是 3i。

entries.en: The bakery will keep open until nine during the summer festival.
entries.zh: 夏季节庆期间，这家面包店将营业至九点。

entries.en: The test report gives the generator’s fuel consumption rate in litres per hour.
entries.zh: 测试报告以升每小时为单位，给出了这台发电机的燃料消耗率。

entries.en: The profiler showed a pause during garbage collection after the temporary arrays became unreachable.
entries.zh: 临时数组变得不可达后，性能分析器显示程序在无用单元的收集期间出现了一次暂停。

entries.en: The history class compared the form of government of the two ancient city-states.
entries.zh: 历史课比较了这两个古代城邦的政体。

entries.en: The coach substituted the centre before he could foul out of the basketball game.
entries.zh: 教练在中锋可能因犯规被罚出这场篮球赛之前，将他换下了场。

entries.en: The architects plan to glass over the courtyard so it can be used in winter.
entries.zh: 建筑师们计划用玻璃覆盖庭院，以便冬天也能使用。

entries.en: The survey team could not go deep into the cave because the passage was flooded.
entries.zh: 勘测队无法进入洞穴深处，因为通道被水淹没了。

entries.en: I’ll have kittens if the last train is cancelled and we cannot get home tonight.
entries.zh: 如果末班火车取消、我们今晚回不了家，我会急得团团转。

entries.en: We ordered a hot pot with mushrooms and tofu to share at the table.
entries.zh: 我们点了一份加蘑菇和豆腐的火锅，大家围桌分享。

entries.en: The typist pressed the home key to move the cursor to the start of the line.
entries.zh: 打字员按下起始键，把光标移到了行首。

entries.en: A thin lead sheet lay between the two layers in the museum’s cutaway model.
entries.zh: 博物馆的剖面模型中，两层之间夹着一片薄铅片。

entries.en: The compiler’s internal representation stores each expression as a small tree.
entries.zh: 编译器的内部表示法把每个表达式存储为一棵小树。

entries.en: The baseball team brought in a heavy hitter to strengthen the middle of its batting order.
entries.zh: 这支棒球队引进了一名有力击球员，以加强打击顺序的中段实力。
